title: Mara and the Smile
author: Zephyrine Iversen
blurb: Astrid Halloran, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
